Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 20s goddess, curved bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous, a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below, but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, high ponytail balayage hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of ultra-thin glossy royal-blue latex, made of two small triangle cups each edged with a thin polished chrome ring and held by thin halter strings behind her neck and back, joined to the bottom by one rigid flat polished chrome bar about one finger wide running straight down the center of her stomach from between the cups to the front of the bottom, with three round chrome rivets set along it, her waist sides, her flanks, her stomach and the skin around the bar bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the latex shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The materials show real behaviour: the polished chrome bar and rivets reflecting sharp bright highlights against her skin, the thin latex molded so closely that it shows the dip of her navel and her hip bones, fine pull-creases and a deep mirror shine. Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.

Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows medium body oil, moderate skin glistening, healthy oiled appearance.

Background: a party table in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic champagne cork with its gold foil and wire cage beside a giant green bottle, giant shiny confetti pieces and curled ribbons scattered around, giant gold balloons floating behind, a softly blurred party hall far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall sitting on top of the giant cork with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm festive light with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous champagne cork, confetti and balloons around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
